cohort: Singleton, vertex births at 36 weeks of gestation or greater without prior cesarean delivery
finding: While rates of spontaneous vaginal birth without serious morbidity decreased with increasing second-stage labor duration, there was no specific time point where morbidity risks significantly outweighed the chances of spontaneous vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The study examined the relationship between second-stage labor duration and the likelihood of spontaneous vaginal birth with no morbidity compared to birth with complications, considering epidural use and parity.
